items.title: Complete failbunny.com launch-readiness evidence before implementation
items.summary: failbunny.com is queue-ready but lacks evidenced audience, content scope, analytics, monetization, compliance, security, and measurement readiness. Create one bounded readiness artifact before admitting implementation work.
items.requested_action: In the existing failbunny.com scaffold, create docs/launch-readiness.md covering audience, homepage scope, initial content, metadata/SEO, analytics and affiliate readiness, compliance/security gates, measurement plan, preview-only launch boundary, rollback, and exactly one next implementation step. Use existing registry and retained intelligence only; do not request telemetry, deploy, spend, change credentials, or publish.
